ComingSoon.title: {feature} — coming in a later phase
ComingSoon.body: This part of the platform is planned but not built yet. We are building the educational foundation first so that every feature rests on reviewed, traceable content.

Home.heroBody: Evidence-based, nursing-specific education for adult ICU nurses anywhere in the world: what to assess, what to monitor, what is abnormal, when to escalate and what to document.
Home.domainsIntro: A structured curriculum from airway and ventilation to professional practice, written for beginner, intermediate and advanced ICU nurses.
Home.how1Body: References show the organisation, guideline version and the date the source was last checked. Draft guidelines are always labelled as drafts.
Home.how2Title: Clinical review is recorded, not claimed
Home.how2Body: A topic is published only after named clinical reviewers approve a specific version. The database enforces this; AI-assisted drafts cannot approve themselves.
Home.how3Body: Actions are separated into assessment, monitoring, escalation, independent nursing care, and interventions that need an order or an approved local protocol.
Home.how4Body: International evidence, locale-aware content, right-to-left layouts and no automatic dose conversion. Local policy always takes precedence.
Home.roadmapBody: Clinical skills, a medication reference, patient simulations, examinations and a source-grounded AI assistant are planned for later phases.
Home.disclaimerBody: ICU Nurse Knowledge Map supports learning. It does not replace professional judgement, supervised competency validation or your institution's protocols. No accreditation or certification is claimed.

AccountDeletion.title: Delete your account
AccountDeletion.publicIntro: You can permanently delete your account and the learning data linked to it at any time, from the website or the app. This page explains how, what is deleted and what is kept.
AccountDeletion.demo: Account deletion needs a configured backend. The app is running in demonstration mode.
AccountDeletion.warningBody: Deleting your account signs you out everywhere and permanently erases your profile and learning data. We cannot restore it afterwards, and you cannot sign in again with this account.

erased.w1: Your profile: name, email address, country, language and experience level.
erased.w2: Your progress, bookmarks and saved study schedule.
erased.w3: Your question-bank, study, case and skills attempts and results, and your equipment bookmarks and progress.
erased.w4: Your sign-in sessions on every device.

kept.k1: A short security record that an account was deleted. It contains no name or email address and cannot be traced to you.
kept.k2: Older security log entries made before deletion keep only an anonymous account identifier, never your name or email.
kept.k3: Educational content is not personal data and is unaffected.

AccountDeletion.recovery: Our hosting provider may keep encrypted backups for a limited time. They are used only to recover the service, are not used to restore individual accounts, and expire automatically.

steps.s1: Sign in to your account. If you signed in more than ten minutes ago you will be asked to sign in again.
steps.s2: Open Account, then Delete your account.
steps.s3: Type your email address and tick the box to confirm that you understand this is permanent.
steps.s4: Select Delete my account permanently and confirm. You are signed out and sent to a confirmation page.

AccountDeletion.staffBody: Accounts with a staff role (author, clinical reviewer, publisher or administrator), and accounts that hold clinical review records that must be kept, cannot be deleted here. An administrator removes the role first. Contact the administrator of your organisation.

Practice.title: Practice labs
Practice.intro: Short interactive exercises for the practical side of nursing work: structured communication (SBAR), documentation, monitoring and escalation, infection prevention, equipment checks and competency self-assessment.
Practice.fixturesBanner: SYNTHETIC NONCLINICAL EXERCISES. Every exercise here is about a fictional workshop and was written to test the software. It is not nursing guidance. Real practical content is held as unpublished drafts and is not shown here.
